title: Hearty Norwegian Cheese Casserole
description: A briny and snappy Norwegian dish featuring cheese, cooked to perfection on a hot stone plate, perfect for a light and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the crumbly goat cheese, sliced fennel, and chopped parsley.
Season the salmon fillets with salt, black pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Brush the hot stone plate with olive oil and place the salmon fillets on it.
Spoon the cheese and fennel mixture over the salmon fillets.
Cook for 12 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the salmon is cooked through.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
